_about: Phase 1 stress-testing tasks. Target quantity: the conditional detection rate p(L, q | x) of a policy on one fixed series x, i.e. the share of all event positions at which the policy reports a new episode (engine/include/sf/evaluate.hpp). It is not a damage bound and says nothing about other series. A cell is one (length L, strength q); a trial is one random position in one cell and serves every policy of the task at once. Tasks derive from base_task by changing the fields they list; ladders change one factor of base_task at a time. Units (series per trial) are a separate multiplier, reported apart and assumed linear.

T1-curve._question: How does the detection rate of the default policy change with event length and strength?

T2-policy-map._question: The same curve for 24 policy settings, with all cells and policies covered at once.

validation_task._about: Run end to end on the reference machine to check the projection (F4). Cell by cell, fixed trial counts.
